positive_intervention.target_ce: compute_qwen_split_target_ce on POSITIVE_INTERVENTION rows and target frame masks only
positive_intervention.preservation_kl: compute_qwen_split_preservation_kl on non-target frames against frozen native teacher-forced logits
positive_intervention.eos_preservation: optional existing masked q0 KL; default lambda_eos=0.0

native_preservation.preservation_kl: available against native teacher-forced logits when a conditioned comparison path is constructed

mixed_batch_rule: Native rows are excluded from the CE index before CE computation; they cannot create an empty target CE mask error.
